sentences.text: Brick Mansions is a 2014 English-language French-Canadian crime-thriller film starring Paul Walker , David Belle and RZA .	Paul Walker	Paul Walker	David Belle	David Belle	RZA	Rza	French-Canadian	French Canadian	crime	crime film	thriller film	thriller (genre)

The film was directed by Camille Delamarre and written by Luc Besson , Robert Mark Kamen and Bibi Naceri .	Camille Delamarre	Camille Delamarre	Luc Besson	Luc Besson	Bibi Naceri	Bibi Naceri	Robert Mark Kamen	Robert Mark Kamen
It is a remake of the 2004 French film District 13 , in which Belle had also starred .	remake	remake	District 13	District 13
Brick Mansions was released on April 25 , 2014 , five months after Paul Walker 's death on November 30 , 2013 and has a dedication to him at the start of the credits .	Paul Walker	Paul Walker
This is Walker 's last completed film before his death , but not his last film appearance .
